title: 01 / A customer asks a product question
caption: From orbinsunny7306@gmail.com to orbinsunny7983@gmail.com
A 90 kg rider asks for a board recommendation and included accessories.

title: 02 / The support mailbox receives it
caption: The real query arrives in the integrated Gmail account.
The worker reads the thread and classifies the latest customer message.

title: 03 / A grounded reply, sent automatically
caption: The agent recommends the 11-foot All-round and lists the included accessories.
The thread receives ai-processed; this question does not require escalation.

title: 04 / The customer receives the answer
caption: The reply arrives in the original Gmail conversation.
Waiting time between sending and delivery has been cut from this walkthrough.

title: 05 / A saved conversation for the support team
caption: Ticket 102 is answered in the paddle-boards category.
The dashboard stores both messages. Unrelated ticket rows are masked.

title: 06 / Product facts come from the knowledge base
caption: The classifier selects paddle-boards; the agent retrieves the relevant section.
For a 90 kg rider, the 11-foot board supports up to 110 kg.

title: 07 / Maintained content shapes the response
caption: The included-accessories entry supplies the second part of the answer.
Operators can edit entries here; this walkthrough leaves their content unchanged.

title: 08 / Processing is observable
caption: Event 137 completed on its first attempt with action=reply.
Events show status, attempts, errors and creation time; decisions are stored in the API.

title: 09 / Evals check the output decisions
caption: Pydantic Evals checks section and action across six golden emails.
Supplied run: 11/12 assertions passed (91.7%). One angry-refund assertion failed.
